name: Intermountain Mesh (Freq51)
area: Salt Lake Valley, Tooele County, Utah County, Davis and Weber counties; also Boise and Twin Falls, Idaho

mqtt.advice: Turn on OK to MQTT so your node is listed on their network stats sites. The MQTT server address is given on Discord.

notes: The primary channel must be named exactly Freq51 with key 1A==. A radio left on the blank default channel will not work here.
They ask you to type channel names and keys by hand and not to import QR codes or URLs.
CLIENT_MUTE is for mobile, handheld or indoor radios; CLIENT is for stationary outdoor nodes. ROUTER and ROUTER_LATE are by coordination only.
Licensed (ham) mode must stay off on slot 51.
Settings are dated 2025-10-05 on their page.
